header.title: Sidebar
header.description: Side navigation for apps with many sections, like admin panels or internal tools. It shows a header on top, the link list in the middle and a footer at the bottom. It can collapse into a narrow icon rail to give the content more room, and on small screens it turns into a panel that opens from a menu button. It renders an `<aside>` with a `<nav>` inside.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and see the result and the code instantly. Use the arrow button to collapse the sidebar.
playground.note: The demo uses position="static" so the sidebar fills the height of the box.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass `header`, `items` and `footer`. Each item needs an `id` and a `label`, and it's best to give it an `icon`: without one, the first letter of the label is shown. The arrow button collapses the sidebar into an icon rail; while collapsed, each icon shows its label in a tooltip. The demos use `position="static"` because they live inside a box with a fixed height.
base.note: Use the arrow to collapse the sidebar. With focus inside, Escape collapses it too. Hover an icon to see its label.

collapsed.title: Collapsed and controlled
collapsed.description: With `collapsed` and `onCollapsedChange` the state lives in your component, for example to save it in `localStorage` and remember it between visits. If you only want it to start collapsed, use `defaultCollapsed`. To hide the button and keep the sidebar always expanded, pass `collapsible={false}`.

texts.note: This example starts collapsed. Hover or focus an icon to read its label.

nested.title: Nested groups
nested.description: An item with `items` becomes a group that opens and closes. `defaultOpen` sets whether it starts open. The group doesn't navigate: it only shows or hides its children. While collapsed the children are hidden and only the group icon remains, so keep the most used links at the first level.
nested.note: Workspace starts open and Archive is disabled. Collapse the sidebar to see how groups hide.

end.title: Right side
end.description: `side="end"` places the sidebar on the end side (the right in left-to-right languages). The border and the collapse arrow flip automatically. In the layout, the container has to place the sidebar after the content, for example with `flex-direction: row-reverse`.
end.note: The sidebar is on the right and the arrow points outward to collapse it.

slots.title: Header, extra content and footer
slots.description: `header`, `children` and `footer` accept any node. `children` renders below the links, useful for an action button, and hides while collapsed. The footer always stays at the bottom, separated by a border. Here the sidebar uses `bordered={false}` and `shadow="md"` to separate from the content with a shadow.
slots.note: The New project button goes in children and the user card in footer.

responsive.title: Small screens
responsive.description: Below `overlayBreakpoint` the sidebar hides and a menu button appears. Tapping it opens the sidebar as a panel covering 90% of the width, with a dark backdrop behind; it closes with the close button, Escape, tapping the backdrop or choosing a link (`closeOnItemClick`). It depends on the window width, not the box: this example uses `overlayBreakpoint="lg"`, so shrink the window below 1024px to see it. With `isOpen` and `onOpenChange` you can control the panel.
responsive.note: Shrink the window below 1024px: the sidebar is replaced by a menu button that opens the panel.

items.sm: Default. The sidebar shows on tablets and only becomes a panel on phones.
items.md: When the content needs more width on portrait tablets.
items.lg: For layouts with wide content, like tables or editors.
items.never: The sidebar stays at every size. Useful if you handle responsiveness yourself.

position.title: Placement in the layout
position.description: `position` sets how the sidebar is placed. `sticky` (default) stays at the top with the window height while the page scrolls. `fixed` pins it to the window edge: the content has to leave room with a margin equal to the sidebar width. `static` takes the height of its container, as in the demos. In an app, put the sidebar and the content in a flex container and give the content `min-w-0` so it doesn't push the sidebar.

styles.tailwindNote: 14rem width, subtle background, colored border and rounded items with Tailwind utilities.
styles.cssNote: A custom class changes the Sidebar variables and the colors of the items and buttons.

header.title: Sidebar API
header.description: API reference for the Sidebar React component: props, items, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It accepts the <aside> HTML attributes (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) and passes them to that element. The <aside> lives inside a .gem-sidebar-root with display: contents, which also holds the menu button and the panel backdrop on small screens. classNames adds classes to each part: root, header, nav, list, item, extras, footer, toggle, menu and backdrop.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.landmark: The root is an <aside> and the links live inside a <nav> with navLabel as its aria-label.
a11y.toggle: The collapse button has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the <nav>. Its label switches between expandLabel and collapseLabel.
a11y.collapsed: While collapsed, each item gets its label as aria-label and shows it in a tooltip on hover or focus.
a11y.nested: Groups are buttons with aria-expanded. When closed, their children are inert and don't receive focus.
a11y.current: The item with current gets aria-current="page". Disabled items render as <button disabled>.
a11y.escape: With focus inside the expanded sidebar, Escape collapses it. With the panel open on small screens, Escape closes it.
a11y.overlay: On small screens, the menu button has aria-expanded. With the panel closed, the <aside> is inert; with the panel open, the page doesn't scroll behind it.
a11y.labels: navLabel, expandLabel, collapseLabel, menuLabel and closeLabel default to English. Pass translated values if your app uses another language.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.wrapper: Container with `display: contents`. Adds `--overlay` and `--open` on small screens.
rules.root: The `<aside>` element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Defines the Sidebar variables.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Draws the border on the content side.
rules.collapsed: Applied while collapsed. Uses `--gem-sidebar-width-collapsed` and hides labels, groups and `children`.
rules.overlay: Applied below `overlayBreakpoint`. Turns the sidebar into a fixed panel.
rules.open: Applied when the panel is open on small screens.
rules.header: Header with the `header` content and the collapse or close button.
rules.toggle: Collapse button, or close button on small screens.
rules.nav: The `<nav>` element with its own scroll. Holds the list and `children`.
rules.list: The `<ul>` list of items. Groups also use `.gem-sidebar__list--nested`.
rules.item: Each link or button. Uses `aria-current` for the active state.
rules.control: Button of a group with children.
rules.fallback: Initial shown when the item has no `icon`.
rules.label: Item text. Truncated with an ellipsis when it doesn't fit.
rules.panel: Animated container for a group's children. Adds `--open` when open.
rules.footer: Container for `footer`, at the bottom, with a top border.
rules.menu: Menu button that opens the panel on small screens.
rules.backdrop: Dark backdrop behind the panel. Tapping it closes the panel.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They're defined on `.gem-sidebar` and none are written inline, so you can change them from your own class (`.gem-sidebar.my-class`) or with Tailwind utilities.

items.--gem-sidebar-border: Color of the side border and the footer border.
items.--gem-sidebar-scrollbar-thumb: Thumb color. Defaults to the text color at 28%.
items.--gem-sidebar-scrollbar-thumb-hover: Thumb color on hover. Defaults to the text color at 45%.

items.--gem-color-primary-500: Base of the active item background and the initial.
items.--gem-z-modal: Layer of the panel on small screens.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the `<aside>`.

items.header: Header content: brand, title or any node.
items.items: Navigation items. An item with `items` becomes a group.
items.footer: Footer content: user card, button or any node.
items.children: Extra content below the list. Hidden while collapsed.
items.side: Side of the sidebar: start or end.
items.position: How the sidebar is placed: inside its container, stuck to the top on scroll or pinned to the window.
items.bordered: Draws a border on the content side.
items.collapsible: Shows the button to collapse and expand.
items.collapsed: Collapsed state in controlled mode. Use it with `onCollapsedChange`.
items.defaultCollapsed: Initial collapsed state in uncontrolled mode.
items.expandLabel: Accessible label of the button while collapsed.
items.collapseLabel: Accessible label of the button while expanded.
items.overlayBreakpoint: Window width below which the sidebar becomes a panel with a menu button. `never` keeps it always.
items.isOpen: Panel state on small screens, in controlled mode. Use it with `onOpenChange`.
items.defaultOpen: Initial panel state on small screens.
items.menuLabel: Accessible label of the menu button.
items.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button and the panel backdrop.
items.closeOnItemClick: Closes the panel when an item is chosen, only on small screens.
items.onCollapsedChange: Called when the sidebar collapses or expands.
items.onOpenChange: Called when the panel opens or closes, including the automatic close past the breakpoint.

items.label: Item text. Also used in the tooltip while collapsed.
items.href: Target URL. With `href` it renders an `<a>`; without it, a `<button>`.
items.icon: Leading icon. Without one, the first letter of `label` is shown.
items.current: Marks the active page and adds `aria-current="page"`.
items.disabled: Dims it and it can't be activated.
items.items: Children of the item. The item becomes a group that opens and closes.
items.onClick: Called when the item is chosen. Useful to navigate with a router.
